**Business Context:** Be Honest offers secure, private AI-powered mental health counseling through encrypted text conversations. Key features include personalized insights, professional-grade AI counseling, and a strong emphasis on privacy and trust. The platform provides a safe space for mental wellness, with no registration required, and end-to-end encryption for all interactions. Be Honest prioritizes user privacy, with no data collection or sharing, and offers a unique value proposition with its commitment to confidentiality and support.
